visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a black zip-up sweater holds a small microphone and speaks to a woman in a black dress in a brightly lit banquet hall. The woman laughs enthusiastically, covering her mouth with her hand. White tablecloths and people are visible in the blurred background. (2) The same man stands on a stage next to a clear acrylic ballot box labeled 'Maestro Art'. He draws a white paper roll, unrolls it to show the number '1', and smiles broadly towards the camera while looking up. (3) A man in a navy blue suit and black bowtie speaks directly to the camera against a neutral grey curtain. He uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize his words. (4) A rapid montage follows, showing various contestants: a man in a light blue shirt holds the number '10', another holds '8', and a young woman in a tan coat holds '4'. Other participants wave and smile in a dining environment. (5) The man in the suit returns, speaking professionally. Occasional cuts show him on a stage in a large auditorium, holding a microphone in front of a grand piano. (6) Two women are interviewed in a hallway; one is the interviewer from the start, and the other is a young female contestant in black. Later, they are joined by another young woman with long dark hair. (7) An older man with long grey hair and a mustache, wearing a suit, speaks to the camera in a professional setting. (8) Two more men in suits appear in quick succession, delivering short messages. (9) The man in the navy suit concludes his talk, pressing his hands together and bowing slightly in gratitude.
